name: Occupancy Rate
query:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT ip.name) AS "Total Patients:Int:120",

    SUM(
        DATEDIFF(
            LEAST(
                DATE(IFNULL(ip.discharge_datetime, %(to_date)s)),
                %(to_date)s
            ),
            GREATEST(
                DATE(ip.admitted_datetime),
                %(from_date)s
            )
        )
    ) AS "Occupied Bed Days:Int:160",

    DATEDIFF(%(to_date)s, %(from_date)s) + 1 AS "Days in Period:Int:130",

    110 AS "Total Beds:Int:100",

    110 * (DATEDIFF(%(to_date)s, %(from_date)s) + 1) AS "Available Bed Days:Int:170",

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(
                DATEDIFF(
                    LEAST(
                        DATE(IFNULL(ip.discharge_datetime, %(to_date)s)),
                        %(to_date)s
                    ),
                    GREATEST(
                        DATE(ip.admitted_datetime),
                        %(from_date)s
                    )
                )
            )
            / (110 * (DATEDIFF(%(to_date)s, %(from_date)s) + 1))
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS "Occupancy Rate:Percent:160"

FROM `tabInpatient Record` ip

WHERE DATE(ip.admitted_datetime) <= %(to_date)s
  AND DATE(IFNULL(ip.discharge_datetime, %(to_date)s)) >= %(from_date)s;
